Family History

Dragov lays out the ground rules for his family of Rikers Features JAMES DRAGOV. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

I chose the law. And all I saw was a different side of the same coin. Police? Corrupt thugs, taking petty bribes. Division? Hah. Delusional killers of the highest order. The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. You... yeah. You're criminals. I am too. We all are. But you didn't deserve what they did to you. So now, we'll take what we can. It's time to ring in a new era! [1]
